messages:
michael: Heads-up — seeing repeated CUDA OOMs on prod-gpu-1 after the kernel selection tweak (auto-switch to fast-kernel-v3). Lots of failed allocations in the last 30m.

sachin: yup. p95/p99 latency mostly fine but memory peaks 92-96% on 48GB nodes, allocator logs show `cudaMalloc failed: out of memory` and then retries.

elaine: can we put kernel switch behind a soft flag? fast-kernel-v3 seems to use larger ephemeral buffers in some attention paths.

infra-bot: :warning: alert: prod-gpu-1 OOM spike detected (1851199900 - 1851199990) — 20 incidents.

kyle: immediate mitigation proposal: enable circuit breaker for `text-gen` pipelines at 85% node memory usage -> either reject or route to fallback/dedicated.

maria: quick CB config suggestion (for staging/ops):
```
circuit_breaker:
  memory_threshold: 0.85
  action: fallback_model_or_reject
  fallback: redwood-small-8bit
  cooldown_s: 120
```

jess: also apply request-shaping: cap tokens per request to 1024 and throttle concurrent inflight per workspace to 10 — prevents single workspace storms.

sachin: profiling snapshot (recent window): p50 70ms, p95 220ms, p99 480ms. Avg batch size ~6, but when failures start we see bursty batches ~12-18 which blows memory.

michael: KV cache note — cold-start storms are filling KV cache entries and pushing memory peaks. Short-term: reduce default KV TTL from 1h -> 10m and cap total per-model KV to 4GB.

elaine: longer-term allocator changes: enable soft-reserve ~2GB on 48GB nodes, more aggressive buffer reuse on free paths, and smaller workspace sizing for attention kernels to avoid oversized temporaries.

kyle: ops runbook commands (ops only):
```
# route text-gen to fallback model
curl -X POST $ADMIN/route -d '{"route":"text-gen","model":"redwood-small-8bit"}'
# reduce kv cache ttl
curl -X POST $ADMIN/config -d '{"kvcache_ttl":600}'
# toggle soft reserve
curl -X POST $ADMIN/config -d '{"gpu_soft_reserve_mb":2048}'
```

maria: I'll author a compact incident playbook now: 1) enable CB @85% 2) route to fallback 3) reduce KV TTL & per-model KV cap 4) apply token/concurrency caps 5) set soft-reserve and buffer-reuse flags 6) monitor p99 & mem for 30m.

jess: can we add an automated test that reproduces cold-KV + many concurrent long-token requests? want that in CI before we roll fast-kernel-v3 to prod.

michael: agreed — sachin + jess please pair on stress harness. I'll open a rollback PR for the kernel switch if we exceed 10 OOMs in the next 30m.

deploy-bot: rollback job queued for fast-kernel-v3 (requested by michael) — ETA ~4m.

sachin: monitoring -> https://grafana.internal/r/abcd , I'll post updates and memory graphs in 5m.

maria: added :thumbsup: to playbook draft and will push a short runbook to ops channel.

elaine: after this stabilizes, we should analyze kernel-generated workspace allocation histograms and kernel-local temp allocations — suspicious spikes line up with certain sequence-length buckets.

michael: good call. log everything to the incident channel and capture one failing allocation trace for the runtime team to profile.

infra-bot: note: incident ticket #INF-4218 created and linked to this thread.
